metadata.title: Formalized Lean 4 Series (Papers 1-6): Shioda-Aoki Characters, Artinian Gorenstein Apolarity, Spin(8) Triality, Order-8 Gauss-Manin Jets, Cyclotomic Incidence Sieves, and Conditional Fermat Bridges
metadata.description:
Verified release archive accompanying the six-paper Lean 4.35.0 series (13 baseline modules + 7 extension modules, 188 axiom-free kernel declarations, and six peer-review-formatted manuscripts with 12 TikZ diagrams) covering Shioda-Aoki cyclotomic character combinatorics through m=60, m=25 cyclic-coset cones, Wiebe-Scheja-Storch transition determinants (G<=3 over Z), Spin(8) triality and idempotent Weil projectors, order-8 Gauss-Manin jet transport, non-Fermat 3-var quotient palindromicity, Cayley-trick complete-intersection profiles in P^6, Poly6 evaluation homomorphisms, and conditional Fermat algebraicity bridges.

Scope and Conditional Interfaces: Every unconditional Lean 4 theorem in this deposit proves exact finite-dimensional combinatorial, polynomial-quotient, or Lie-algebraic results, while classical Lefschetz, Griffiths, Shioda, and Aoki algebraic-geometry bridges are isolated inside explicit modular hypothesis structures (FermatFourfoldHodgeBridge).
metadata.notes: All 6 manuscripts passed pdflatex (0 errors, 0 overfull, 0 underfull, >= 2 TikZ figures each) and live SHA-256 verification against FULL_AUTOMATION_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json and MILLENNIUM_EXT_RECEIPT.json.
